turn_text: Joining us on the live line is Congresswoman Lauren Underwood. She has just been in the Washington Post discussing the Affordable Care Act, and we're so happy to have her on our afternoon show for the first time. Congresswoman, I want to thank you so much for joining us.

And this is for a silver level plan on the marketplace, so good coverage. And it ended up passing the Congress last year, but didn't pass the Senate. Well, the Biden team heard about our legislation. And so I wanted to write this up and telling a story about a constituent of mine. and how she had written in, talking about her quest to find healthcare and how this was such a great solution for her family. I thought that was something that was obviously so relatable to folks and our friends at the Washington Post agreed.
